scope: Seven hash-selected examples per allowed rule were manually read. All alternatives are invalid after the visible prefix. Some contexts recur across templated training documents. This is not exhaustive semantic validation.

rules.first_person: I has/I is invalid in the reviewed contexts.
rules.plural: We/they has invalid in the reviewed contexts.
rules.modal: Inflected forms after explicit pronoun+modal invalid in the reviewed contexts.

excluded: Article and perfect-participle future-conditioned rules are absent from the training sidecar.
